title: comparison constant generator
statement: For a commutative ring A, scheme D and a∈A, the etale constant-presheaf generator a, followed by the comparison adjunction unit and the canonical constant-sheaf comparison, equals the pro-etale constant-presheaf generator a at the terminal object [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism].

source.place: Derived reduction, finite coefficient extension and canonical comparison paragraphs

proof.text: The canonical constant comparison is uniqueness of left adjoints between the composite of constant-sheaf and comparison adjunctions and the pro-etale constant-sheaf adjunction. Their unit compatibility equation, evaluated on the coefficient module and then on a, is precisely the displayed formula. The section-functor comparison at the terminal object is definitionally the identity.

lean.statement:
theorem comparison_constant_generator (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    (D : Scheme.{u}) (a : A) :
    (((comparisonUpperStarConstantSheafIso A D).app (ModuleCat.of A A)).hom).hom.app
        (op (Scheme.ProEt.mk (𝟙 D)))
      (((comparisonAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) D).unit.app
        (Etale.ordinaryFiniteConstant A D)).hom.app (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 D)))
        ((toSheafify D.smallEtaleTopology
          ((Functor.const D.Etaleᵒᵖ).obj (ModuleCat.of A A))).app
            (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 D))) a)) =
      (toSheafify (Scheme.ProEt.topology D)
        ((Functor.const D.ProEtᵒᵖ).obj (ModuleCat.of A A))).app
          (op (Scheme.ProEt.mk (𝟙 D))) a
